lines: Founded in 1886 by workers at the Royal Arsenal munitions works in Woolwich, under the name Dial Square.
The nickname comes from those works: the club has been the Gunners since its first season.
Went the 2003–04 league season unbeaten, 26 wins and 12 draws, and won the title.
Moved north to Highbury in 1913 and on to the Emirates Stadium in 2006.
The north London derby, against Tottenham Hotspur, has been played since 1909.

lines: Won the European Cup in 1961 and again in 1962, beating Barcelona and then Real Madrid in the finals.
An eagle flies a lap of the Estádio da Luz before home matches; the club is known as As Águias, the Eagles.
A statue of Eusébio, the great forward of the 1960s, stands outside the ground.
The Lisbon derby is against Sporting CP, from the other side of the city.

lore.history: The oldest club in Belgium and the biggest in Antwerp. Brabo United play a mile away, and the old club has noticed.
lore.hiddenTease: The scout says they come alive in the last minutes, as if they remember something.
lines: Holds number 1 in the Belgian football register, the oldest club on the list, which is why it is called The Great Old.
Has played at the Bosuil in Deurne, on the east side of the city, since 1923.
Reached the 1993 Cup Winners’ Cup final at Wembley and lost 3–1 to Parma.
Won the league and cup double in 2023, its first title since 1957, with a goal in the last minute of the season.
The Antwerp derby is against Beerschot, from the south of the city.
